title: Real cutoff for computable circuits
statement: For every natural number $n$, the set of Boolean functions on $n$ input bits computed by a fan-in-two circuit of size at most $2^n/(10n)$, with the size viewed as a real number, equals the set of functions computed by such a circuit of size at most the natural-number quotient $2^n/(10n)$.
